assets.title: Deep Work Block
assets.prompt:
Create ONE original routine poster for Azora, a warm, calm, grown-up home and routine app. Portrait image EXACTLY 1024x1536 pixels, 2:3. Editorial craftsmanship and variety, NOT children's art, app icons, clay toys, or a mobile interface. Palette: warm cream #FDF6F0, deep navy, sky blue, teal, amber, violet, coral and blush. Keep important text and complete objects within x=75..949 and y=105..1425 (at least 6% inside all edges). Only decorative corner shapes may crop off the edges. Title bold and medium-large, using at most 25% of the total image height. All non-checklist titles use the same clean contemporary bold sans-serif family; labels use a neat clear sans-serif, approximately 46-50px, legible at 188pt poster width. Objects small to medium with clear space around each. Add restrained finishing details: cropped corner shapes, thin dividers, tiny sparkles or paper grain appropriate to the style. Original artwork, no logos, app UI, phone frames, watermark, signature or extra words. Every text string must be perfectly spelled and rendered verbatim with exact capitalization and punctuation. Objects such as books, phones, notes and calendars must be unlettered; the supplied text is the ONLY permitted writing.
STYLE F: Flat editorial vector illustration with subtle paper grain on warm cream #FDF6F0. Bold organic colour shapes run off the outer corners. Title top-left and one detailed but medium-sized hero illustration top-right, a fine navy divider below the heading, then a neat grid of small-to-medium illustrated objects with their exact labels BELOW. Three labels use three spacious rows; four labels use a 2x2 grid; five labels use two columns with the last item centered. Deliberate negative space, sophisticated print design, restrained fine detail.
Main colour: violet.
Exact title: "Deep Work Block". Break over 2 or 3 lines as needed without changing words or hyphens.
Hero still life: a focused writing desk with a notebook and a refined analog timer.
Exact labels, in order: ["One Task","Silence Phone","45 Minutes","Real Break"]. Illustrate one distinct recognisable object or small still life corresponding to each label. Do not repeat or add labels.
assets.revisionPrompt: Edit the two timer dials: REMOVE ALL printed numbers and replace with simple unnumbered tick marks. Do not alter the exact label "45 Minutes". Also slightly reduce and reposition the foreground composition so every object and label fits x=80..944,y=110..1410. Keep title and all labels exactly: "Deep Work Block", ["One Task","Silence Phone","45 Minutes","Real Break"]. Keep flat grained editorial art, violet colour, all object types, composition and typography. No other text on objects. Output1024x1536.
